subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Pluralistic Ignorance
description: A quick win: understand Pluralistic Ignorance.

hook.text: Smoke fills a room. Nobody leaves because nobody else is leaving. Everyone privately panics but publicly stays calm.

buildup.text: Pluralistic ignorance: everyone privately rejects a norm but assumes everyone else accepts it.

discovery.text: Latane and Darley's bystander experiments showed that more witnesses paradoxically reduce the chance anyone helps.

twist.text: In meetings, everyone stays silent on a bad idea, each thinking they are the only one who sees the flaw. Nobody speaks.

climax.text: Break the spell by going first. One dissenting voice frees others to speak. Silence is the trap, not agreement.

punchline.text: If everyone seems fine with it, maybe nobody truly is.

quiz.question: What is pluralistic ignorance?
options: Everyone genuinely agreeing with a group decision
Everyone privately disagreeing but assuming everyone else agrees
